name: ABot-World 0.5 Iris: open 5B causal world model turns one image into a real-time, keyboard-controllable video world
title: ABot-World 0.5 Iris: open 5B causal world model turns one image into a real-time, keyboard-controllable video world
summary: AMAP CV Lab released a 5B Apache-2.0 world model that animates a still image into an interactive video scene you can steer while it runs; its causal-chain training raised the reported physical-consistency score from 32.43 to 68.07 when scaled to 1.2M examples.
